claude_proposed_widenings.name: Attachment { kind: "location" }
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Clairvoyance places its sensor at a specific remote location (up to 1 mile) chosen at cast time. No existing Attachment kind covers this: 'self' is the caster, 'target' is a creature/object, 'area' is a shaped region, 'mark' is a tracked target. The v4 taxonomy already has 'location' as an attachment atom — it is currently expressed only in AnchorTarget. It needs to be added to the Attachment union as a first-class variant so ongoing_effect spells can also use it.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You create an Invisible sensor within range in a location familiar to you (a place you have visited or seen before) or in an obvious location that is unfamiliar to you (such as behind a door, around a corner, or in a grove of trees).

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation { kind: "remote_sense" }
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Clairvoyance's ongoing operation is routing the caster's perception (sight or hearing) through the sensor as if the caster were present in its space. This is not roll_modifier or damage_on_hit. The v4 taxonomy has 'grant_sense' as an effect atom. This operation variant would reference that atom but applied directionally through the location attachment — 'use chosen sense via sensor' rather than 'grant a new sense type to the caster'. It needs its own OngoingOperation variant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you cast the spell, choose seeing or hearing. You can use the chosen sense through the sensor as if you were in its space.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation active-control / mode-switch rider
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell allows the caster to spend a Bonus Action to switch the active sense (seeing ↔ hearing) while concentrating. No existing OngoingOperation variant models active player-choice that costs a resource mid-concentration. This is a secondary gap: the remote_sense widening above is required first; mode-switching is an additional rider whose surface shape would need to be specified.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Bonus Action, you can switch between seeing and hearing.
